projects.summary: Founder & Lead Developer. Selected into the Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program with dedicated compute infrastructure. Built a client-side local-first career copilot and explainable skill scoring engine.
projects.content:
# Skillsy - Explainable AI Career Analytics & Skill Diagnostics Platform

**Founder & Lead Developer (Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program Cohort)**

## Overview
Skillsy (accessible at `skillsy.my.id`) addresses the lack of transparency in automated career assessment and recruitment matching. Rather than relying on opaque 'black-box' scoring, Skillsy utilizes a local-first client-side copilot with BYOK LLM integration (Google Gemini, Groq) and weighted evaluation algorithms.

## Program Achievements
- **Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program**: Selected for cohort acceptance, securing dedicated AI/cloud compute credits and specialized architectural consultation from Alibaba Cloud engineers.
- **Bank Indonesia Hackathon (Top 480)**: Advanced the initial prototype into an active AI-driven career analytics startup platform.

## Architecture & Tech Stack
- **Client-Side Manifest V3 Extension**: Local DOM parsing on active job tabs with zero intermediary data harvesting.
- **Explainable Scoring Engine**: Designed rule-assisted knowledge-base scoring algorithms that output direct, interpretable skill diagnostic feedback.
- **Interactive Document Editor**: In-browser PDF resume generator with dynamic floating AI revision bubble.

# Mortgage Intelligence Hub - Enterprise Operations Architecture

**Sales Operations Analyst at 99 Group (Rumah123.com)**

## Challenge
Mortgage sales and operations pipelines were fragmented across 30+ disjointed Google Sheets, banking portals, and CRM telephony records, causing manual cross-referencing delays and reconciliation errors.

## Impact & Engineered Solutions
- **Single Source of Truth**: Architected the centralized RevOps executive dashboard giving management a helicopter view of multi-channel attribution and pipeline performance.
- **Operational Auditing & Accuracy**: Slashed manual cross-referencing cycles and analysis errors by **~80%** with automated data validation pipelines.
- **AI-Driven Lead Quality Audit**: Clustered 8,000+ lead interaction records using NLP to uncover operational SOP deviations and conversion bottlenecks.
- **Take-Over & New Booking Calculators**: Engineered interactive operational tools and pipeline calculators directly deployed for mortgage workflows during major Harpropnas campaigns.

projects.title: Macroeconomic Market Factor Shifts on Tech Equities (Sinta 4)
projects.summary: Peer-reviewed publication in JAMI (Sinta 4 Accredited) evaluating the shift of machine learning feature importance on tech equity behavior across pre- and post-COVID regimes.
projects.content:
# Macroeconomic Market Factor Shifts on Tech Equities

**Published Researcher, JAMI (Jurnal Ahli Muda Indonesia) | Sinta 4 Accredited**

- **Journal**: JAMI (Jurnal Ahli Muda Indonesia) - Vol. 6 No. 2 (Desember 2025)
- **Original Paper Title**: *Pergeseran Feature Importance pada Prediksi Pasar Saham Teknologi Menggunakan Machine Learning: Studi Komparatif Pra dan Pasca Pandemi COVID-19*
- **Lead Author**: Dzaky Rayssa Buntoro (Universitas Muhammadiyah Surakarta)
- **Official DOI**: [10.46510/jami.v6i2.380](https://doi.org/10.46510/jami.v6i2.380)
- **Official OJS Publication**: [View on JAMI Portal (journal.akb.ac.id)](https://journal.akb.ac.id/index.php/jami/article/view/380)
- **Direct PDF Backup**: [View Document on Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Yz-01FNK2vJ1z27GoguI-aCo2pDqa40E/view?usp=sharing)

## Research Scope
Evaluated how shifts in macroeconomic variables (such as Fed interest rate policy, ATR, and VIX) impact predictive market models (XGBoost and Random Forest) for technology sector equities (Invesco QQQ Trust / QQQ) across pre- and post-pandemic market regimes.

## Methodology & Findings
- Quantitative econometric and machine learning modeling using Python, scikit-learn, and pandas.
- Findings indicate a measurable increase in post-pandemic predictability, with feature importance shifting from purely technical indicators to macroeconomic and volatility determinants.

articles.title: Why Explainable AI Beats Black-Box Scoring in Career & Skill Diagnostics
articles.excerpt: Lessons learned from building Skillsy under the Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst Program: structured knowledge bases versus opaque embeddings.
articles.content:
# Why Explainable AI Beats Black-Box Scoring in Career & Skill Diagnostics

When we founded **Skillsy**, we realized the biggest pitfall in automated HR and recruitment tech: candidate distrust in opaque AI scores.

## The Black-Box Problem
Candidates who receive a score of '72%' with no breakdown have no actionable path forward.

## Our Solution at Skillsy
By combining weighted structured knowledge bases with transparent LLM validation, we provide deterministic, actionable gap feedback.
